claim: Spawn (DEATH3) carries the victim's velocities to the egg VERBATIM: LDD PVELY,U / STD PVELY,Y then LDA PVELX,U / STA PVELX,Y — 'SAME VELOCITIES'.
Spawn RESETS the egg's bump registers: CLR PBUMPX,Y (and CLR PBUMPY,Y next line) — 'RESET BUMPAGE REGISTERS'. The inherited velocities carry, the shoves do not.
The egg inherits the enemy's remaining egg count: LDA PEGG,U — 'TRANSFER NBR OF EGG LEFT'.

source.verbatim: LDA	PEGG,U		TRANSFER NBR OF EGG LEFT

claim: Each spawned egg DECrements the count: DEC PEGG,Y — 'YOU CAN ONLY SQUEEZE SO MUCH BLOOD FROM AN EGG'. This is the permadeath counter.

source.verbatim: DEC	PEGG,Y		YOU CAN ONLY SQUEEZE SO MUCH BLOOD FROM AN EGG

claim: After the DEC, BNE means eggs remain (the egg will hatch); falling through (PEGG reached 0) is permadeath — 'BR=YOU CAN GET MORE EGGS'.

source.verbatim: BNE	1$		 BR=YOU CAN GET MORE EGGS

claim: An enemy carries 4 eggs before permadeath: LDA #4 — '4 EGGS BEFORE ENEMY R.I.P.'S' (stored to PEGG,Y next line).
Ledge eggs are placed every 8th pixel position: LDB #8 — 'PUT AN EGG EVERY 8TH PIXEL POSITION' (the MUL two lines down scales the slot index by 8).

source.verbatim: LDB	#8		PUT AN EGG EVERY 8TH PIXEL POSITION

claim: EGLEDG is the cumulative ledge-egg count per cliff tier; LEVEL0 (CLIF1L,CLIF1R) = 3+5 = 8 slots.
EGLEDG LEVEL5 (CLIF5) cumulative = 3+5+11+7+7+5+8+23 = 69 — the total number of ledge egg slots across all six tiers.
The egg uses a NARROWER wrap than an entity: CMPD #288 — 'NEW WRAP AROUND STYLE (4 TO 288)'. This runs AFTER the normal WRAPX.

source.verbatim: CMPD	#288		NEW WRAP AROUND STYLE (4 TO 288)

claim: Egg wrap upper correction: an X past 288 subtracts the 284-unit span (ADDD #4-288 = ADDD #-284).
Egg wrap lower bound: CMPD #4 — an X below 4 gets the correction added.
Egg wrap lower correction: an X below 4 adds the 284-unit span (ADDD #288-4 = ADDD #284), completing the [4,288] band.
On a bounce the egg's positive FLYX X index decays 2 toward zero: ADDA #-2 (EGGVX path).
On a bounce the egg's negative FLYX X index decays 2 toward zero: EGGVXM ADDA #2 — the mirror of the positive decay.
The bounced Y velocity keeps a QUARTER of itself: ASRA (with the RORB/ASRA/RORB that follow, an arithmetic >>2 of the 16-bit D).
After the >>2, the Y velocity is INVERTED: COMA (with NEGB / SBCA #-1) is the 6809 16-bit two's-complement negate — so velY' = -(velY>>2).
Settle threshold on velY: CMPD #-$0020 — the bounced (upward) velY is compared against -$20.
BLT here means the egg is STILL bouncing: a velY faster (more negative) than -$20 keeps falling — 'BR=STILL TOO FAST TO LAND'. Settle needs velY >= -$20.

source.verbatim: BLT	EGGBCK		BR=STILL TOO FAST TO LAND

claim: Settle also needs the X index at exactly 0: LDA PVELX,U / BNE keeps bouncing — 'BR=STILL TOO FAST TO LAND'. A nonzero index never settles.

source.verbatim: BNE	EGGBCK		BR=STILL TOO FAST TO LAND

claim: EGGVAL value ladder entry 1: FCB $52 → 250 (DVALUE-decoded via SCRTEN as tens/hundreds, not a raw x100).
EGGVAL value ladder entry 2: FCB $05 → 500 (via SCRHUN).
EGGVAL value ladder entry 3: FCB $57 → 750 (via SCRTEN — the $57->750 trap, NOT 5700).
EGGVAL value ladder entry 4: FCB $10 → 1000 (via SCRHUN) — 'PEG AT 1,000', the cap for the 4th and every later hit.
The egg-hit counter pegs at 4: CMPB #4 — 'THE MAGIC MAXIMUM NUMBER IS 4' (BHS skips the increment at/above 4, capping the ladder at 1000).

source.verbatim: CMPB	#4		THE MAGIC MAXIMUM NUMBER IS 4

claim: The mid-air catch bonus is gated on PFEET: LDA PFEET,Y — 0 means the egg was caught before bouncing (bonus live).
A mid-air catch scores an extra 500: LDA #$05 — 'SCORE 500 POINTS' (via SCRHUN, in the player's workspace).
On hatch the egg signals a buzzard to fly in: LDA #EMYID — 'SIGNAL BUZARD TO START FLYING IN!'.

source.verbatim: LDA	#EMYID		SIGNAL BUZARD TO  START FLYING IN!

claim: The hatching buzzard carries the enemy's remaining egg count forward: LDA PEGG,U — 'MAINTAIN NBR OF EGGS LEFT IN THE BIRD' (permadeath persists through remounts).

source.verbatim: LDA	PEGG,U		MAINTAIN NBR OF EGGS LEFT IN THE BIRD

claim: The fly-in buzzard moves at MAX FLYX speed 8: STA PVELX,Y — 'AT MAXIMUM WARP SPEED' (LDA #8 the line above).

source.verbatim: STA	PVELX,Y		AT MAXIMUM WARP SPEED

claim: The buzzard enters from the FARTHER edge, not the nearer one: BHI EGGMRT — 'BR=MAN ON RIGHT SIDE OF SCREEN' selects the LEFT-edge start (EGGMRT). This CORRECTS AC-3/epic-law-#7's 'nearer edge' prose (a jt1-10-class wrong-prose citation).

source.verbatim: BHI	EGGMRT		 BR=MAN ON RIGHT SIDE OF SCREEN

claim: Man-on-LEFT case: the buzzard starts at the RIGHT edge, LDD #ERIGHT-1 (=291), flying left (NEG PVELX) toward the rider — the far edge.
Man-on-RIGHT case (EGGMRT): the buzzard starts at the LEFT edge, LDD #ELEFT+1 (=-9), flying right toward the rider — the far edge.
The remount promotes the buzzard to smart: INC PCHASE,U (0->1), paired with MOUNRI's INC NSMART (JT22-015) — the same debit a LINET promotion applies.
The egg's score-message state OVERLAYS PPVELX: STA PPVELX,X — 'SAVE IT IN EGGS PPVELX AREA'. Egg fields reuse the process RAM; the shared struct does not grow (epic tagged-union ruling).

source.verbatim: STA	PPVELX,X	SAVE IT IN EGGS PPVELX AREA

claim: The egg's score value OVERLAYS PRDIR: STB PRDIR,X — 'SAVE SCORE VALUE IN EGGS PRDIR WORKSPACE'. The same RAM-overlay ruling.

source.verbatim: STB	PRDIR,X		SAVE SCORE VALUE IN EGGS PRDIR WORKSPACE
